name: Tallybell
subtitle: Spot renewals, cut waste
shortDescription: Your subscriptions rung up in one calm place. Add them in seconds, get a nudge before each renewal, and sweep out the ones you stopped using.
longDescription:
Small monthly charges add up quietly. Tallybell is a private notebook for every subscription, membership and recurring bill, with a bell that rings a few days before each one renews.

Type in what you pay, how often and when it last hit. Tallybell works out the rest: the next charge, what each plan costs per month and per year, and what lands in the coming weeks. No bank login, no account, no sign-up. Your list lives on your phone.

### What You Get
- Bells: a clear timeline of what renews this week, later this month and next month, with split bills counted at your share.
- Month: a calendar where every charge day carries a coloured dot; tap a day to see what lands on it.
- Reminders: local notifications before renewals and the day before a free trial ends, at the hour you pick.
- Sweep: review one subscription at a time and swipe Keep, Doubt or Cut. Cut items count toward a running yearly saving.
- Cancel checklist: a short list of steps for each subscription you decide to drop, so nothing is left to bill you again.
- Tally: a ring of where the year goes by shelf (watch, listen, learn, move and more), a twelve-month bar chart and your five costliest plans.
- Spreadsheet friendly: import a CSV, paste rows, or share an export any time.
- Many currencies: totals use your main currency; others are listed separately and never converted behind your back.

### Private By Design
Tallybell has no server for your entries. Reminders are scheduled by iOS on the device. Delete everything with one button.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
